hints.title: Grid Partition Total Sum
hints.text: Sum all elements in the grid to verify divisibility by 2.

hints.title: Horizontal Cut Check
hints.text: Accumulate entire rows from top to bottom, checking whether any prefix row sum reaches half the total.

hints.title: Vertical Cut Check
hints.text: Accumulate entire columns from left to right, checking whether any prefix column sum reaches half the total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing entire subgrids for every split introduces unnecessary quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Streaming running sums avoids extra storage beyond loop variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check both horizontal and vertical partition boundaries.
